scenarios.name: add-password
scenarios.why: '02ACUS': INSERT INTO CUSTOMER_SECURE for a generated customer with no password row yet is SQLCODE 0; D2-RETURN-CODE '00'; GenApp's own default password, state 'N', 0 changes

scenarios.name: add-password-count-max
scenarios.why: D2-CUSTSECR-COUNT PIC X(4) '9999' MOVEd to the S9(9) COMP host variable (an alphanumeric sender read as an unsigned integer): pass_changes 9999; the password filled to its 32 bytes

scenarios.name: add-password-count-leading-zeros
scenarios.why: count '0042' -> 42; a short password: CHAR(32) keeps its trailing blanks

scenarios.name: add-password-blanks
scenarios.why: password and state all spaces: the row holds 32 blanks and one blank, not NULL

scenarios.name: add-password-return-code-reset

commarea.D2-CUSTSECR-DATA: trailing data the program never reads

scenarios.why: a non-zero D2-RETURN-CODE on entry is reset to '00'; D2-CUSTSECR-DATA is left as passed

scenarios.name: request-add-customer-id
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER: '01ACUS' (LGACDB01's own request id) is not '02ACUS': '99', RETURN, no INSERT

scenarios.name: request-lowercase
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER: the comparison is byte for byte, '02acus' is not '02ACUS': '99'

scenarios.name: request-blank
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER: a blank request id: '99'

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: IF EIBCALEN IS EQUAL TO ZERO -- EM-VARIABLE ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (it writes the message to TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS: #4607), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea-insert-fails
scenarios.why: #4270 (X23): the caller passed 60 bytes (EIBCALEN 60; every field the INSERT reads lies in them) and INSERT-CUSTOMER-PASSWORD's INSERT (line 166) fails -803: '98', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG, then IF EIBCALEN < 91 is true -- DFHCOMMAREA(1:60) into CA-DATA and the second LINK, whose 104-byte WRITEQ from LGSTSQ's 95-byte WRITE-MSG is written padded (X6, ASSUMED): the whole task is compared

notes: Generated-row sibling (#4507) of genapp-lgacdb02: CUSTOMER (12 rows, numbers 1..12) and CUSTOMER_SECURE (10 rows, each referencing a CUSTOMER row by the foreign key) are generated from base/cntl/db2cre.jcl (NULLs and boundary values; the generator is seeded). With seed 4507 the ten password rows belong to customers 1, 3-6 and 8-12, so customers 2 and 7 are the ones with no password row yet: every '02ACUS' request adds the row for 2 or 7 and the INSERT answers SQLCODE 0 on both sides. A different seed or row count moves the gap: re-check the two numbers (the det-port run fails a request that meets -803). 16 generated requests (password, count '0000'..'9999', state, wrong or blank request id) run beside the stated scenarios. Not generated: a duplicate password row (-803) and the zero-length COMMAREA, whose WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE stamps ASKTIME / FORMATTIME and LINKs LGSTSQ, whose WRITEQ is X6 (oracle_assumptions.md); the stated no-commarea and short-commarea-insert-fails scenarios keep those paths. See genapp-lgacdb02 for the program, the COMMAREA and the LGSTSQ (#4607 / X6, #4270 / X23) notes.
